Interface IOReportCpuSampler

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
@ThreadSafe public interface IOReportCpuSampler extends AutoCloseable
A subscription to the macOS IOReport CPU performance state channels, implemented once per binding.

The two implementations wrap genuinely different native APIs, so only this shape is shared. It exists so MacCentralProcessor can hold the frequency logic once rather than duplicating it per backend.

These channels exist only on Apple Silicon, so a sampler is created only there.
